title: Full Brep CAD Kernel
description: Expand the solid-only brep kernel into a full CAD kernel: multi-entity handle/registry, exhaustive brepkit operations (curves, surfaces, sweeps, features, intersect, evaluate, analysis, IO), flow node catalog, and preview rendering for all entity kinds.
summary: Expanded the solid-only brep stack into a full CAD kernel across engine trait, brepkit implementation, flow node catalog, and preview plumbing. geometry/brep/engine now exposes Curve/Surface kinds, MeshTransfer.points, ParamDomain, ClosestPoint, PointClassification, and ~70 async BrepKernel methods (curves, surfaces, sweeps, booleans, transforms, features, intersect, evaluate, measure, construct, IO). geometry/brep/rs refactored to multi-entity Entity registry with KernelCurve/KernelSurface, exhaustive brepkit wrappers, per-entity tessellation, and 13 kernel tests. flow/modules/brep registers 78 operators in grouped catalog with kind-aware geometry_dict and list/point/vector/text helpers; 8 module tests with serial kernel isolation. geometry/brep/js maps points from WASM tessellation; procedural/react accepts curve-/surface- handles. Added rectangle-extrude-volume procedural fixture. Built flow/core (47.66 MiB) and flow/module-brep (2.51 MiB) wasm; cargo tests pass; procedural/play 42 tests pass.
